verdict.rationale: doola's Registered Agent service documents secure storage for all scanned documents and digital access to mail through the doola dashboard. That is the product's own archive capability, not a notification-only flow. However, nothing states how long documents are retained, or confirms that a notice can be found and retrieved months after receipt. Missing for 10: documented retention period, explicit later retrieval or search of archived notices, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, received documents stay archived in the account so a notice can be retrieved months later, not just at notification time

citations.quote: Receive local document scans within the same day and enjoy secure storage for all scanned documents
Our Registered Agent service enables you to respond quickly by giving you digital access to physical mail via doola's dashboard.
